scope: Three fresh Regional worlds, 180 provinces and 8064 cells each. Resident district simulation. No paid model-provider calls.
sourceIsolation: Runs use an immutable copy of commit 1cfd55f plus the stability changes. Concurrent terrain, hydrology and city-rendering changes in the shared checkout are excluded from these 200-year trajectories.
trajectoryCoverage: Every month from generation to month 2400 is checked. Full annual trajectories and full-run extrema are retained; no late-segment extrapolation.

regressions.notes: 225 non-simulation cases and ten selected simulation cases. The separate 120/240/1200-month cases are covered by the three longer runs, not an unfiltered npm test.

about.search: fertility locates the revised demographic equations
about.method: Actual ModelMathematics component and application dialog/styles in an isolated browser fixture; DOM bounds and interaction checks, not a screenshot qualification.
finalContentChecks: 200-year outcomes and remaining calibration and numerical-bound limitations

acceptanceCriteria.measurementWindow: Last 30 annual observations; endpoint growth rates span 29 elapsed years, food coverage averages all 30 calendar years.

limitations: Synthetic behavioral and production coefficients, not empirically calibrated historical predictions.
Regional scale and these three initial conditions do not establish all-seed or World-scale long-run stability.
Population decline, inflation and secession remain possible under adverse conditions.
Early price-index surges reach 6.62 to 8.33; later price trends remain deflationary and all three populations contract over the final observation window.
The existing numerical wage minimum binds for 8.4 to 38.7 percent of private employment at the endpoints; these trajectories do not establish stability independent of numerical bounds.
correctionsDuringValidation: Removed an extra forest-recovery call after identifying the existing land-use-dependent monthly recovery; an integrated stock/extraction/recovery regression now requires exactly one application.
Closed remaining nominal-service effects in provincial policing, diplomatic staffing and research cooperation; bilateral sharing retains the previous month real output across reset.

intermediateSaveProbe.report: Intermediate probe only; final month-2400 checks remain required.

mergedCheckoutChecks.scope: Short compatibility checks against concurrent terrain changes; excluded from the three frozen-source 200-year trajectories.
mergedCheckoutChecks.notes: These 34 checks overlap the 235 unique selected regressions; they are not additional unique cases.

builds.advisory: Existing bundles above 500 kB after minification.

performance: Three scenarios ran in separate processes. Runtime includes concurrent workload and is not a controlled performance benchmark.
